items.name: Fraser Valley Spring Open 2019

venue.name: [Fort Langley Evangelical Free Church](https://www.flefc.org/)
venue.address: 8870 Glover Road, Fort Langley, BC, Canada V1M 2R9
venue.details: The competition will be located in the gym.

items.information:
You’ve asked. We’ve said yes! Speedcubing is AGAIN coming to the township of Langley! Similar to last year, we look forward to a full house of 90 competitive cubers, this time on SATURDAY MAY 4th, 2019.

The lunch and snack concession is back and CAD or USD **CASH** is required at the competition for those wishing to eat on site here.

**Calling for your volunteer help**. Those previously experienced as scramblers, judges and runners willing to gift some of their time are asked to e-mail [Lindy](mailto:lindy@flefc.org) to say that **of course** you're in!

Volunteering is fun, engages you fully in the day and, with plenty of help, keeps the competition events moving along in a timely manner.  A judging tutorial will be provided just prior to the start of the day.

Anyone who volunteers- yes, parents, too- are eligible to put their name in our draw for little thank you prizes!

See you all there and we appreciate you emailing in to volunteer a portion of your day.

items.name: Please Be Quiet WPI Spring 2019

venue.name: [Worcester Polytechnic Institute](https://www.wpi.edu/)
venue.address: 100 Institute Road, Worcester, Massachusetts, United States

items.information:
3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the main event of this competition!

This is a quiet events competition. We will NOT be holding usual events like 3x3. If you are a new competitor or are in a regular competition, this probably isn't for you, and you may want to check out other local competitions. Spectators may attend for free, but you are likely to get bored very quickly as the events held are quite slow.

Other local competitions:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheBattleofLexington2019
Stay on the lookout for others as well in the coming months!

The competition will be held in Salisbury Labs 105 (SL 105), this building is across the fountain from the campus center. Parking can be found in any of the visitors lots on Institute Rd or on Boynton St.
